definitions.gloss: playback screen; player screen; playback view
definitions.explanation: The screen or interface displayed during audio or video playback on a device or application. Shows controls such as play, pause, and seek, along with the media content.

examples.japanese: {再生画面|さいせいがめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一時停止|いちじていし}→一時停止：05401_ichijiteishi⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: Press the pause button on the playback screen.

examples.japanese: {再生画面|さいせいがめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右下|みぎした}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{字幕|じまく}→字幕：04446_jimaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切替|きりかえ}⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a subtitle toggle button at the bottom right of the playback screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}したら→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧{再生画面|さいせいがめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わっていた→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: After updating the app, the design of the playback screen had changed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧ (playback, reproduction) and ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (screen). Commonly encountered in help pages and user guides for streaming services, music apps, and media players. With the popularity of streaming services in Japan (Netflix, Amazon Prime, YouTube, etc.), this is a term learners will encounter in everyday digital life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再生画面|さいせいがめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open the playback screen
- {再生画面|さいせいがめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the playback screen
- {再生画面|さいせいがめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧: playback screen controls
- フルスクリーン{再生画面|さいせいがめん}: fullscreen playback view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧: playback — the act of playing media, without reference to the screen
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: screen — any screen or display, not specific to playback
- プレーヤー⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: player screen — alternative way to say the same thing using the loanword
